# Test Plan X Gold PPO: Summary of Benefits, plan year 2027

| Benefit | In-network member cost | Out-of-network member cost |
|---|---|---|
| Deductible (individual / family) | $1,300 / $2,600 | $3,000 / $6,000 |
| Out-of-pocket maximum (individual / family) | $5,000 / $10,000 | $9,000 / $18,000 |
| Specialist visit | $55 copay | 40% coinsurance after deductible |
| Telehealth (video) visit | $12 copay | Not covered |
| Behavioral health outpatient visit (in person or virtual) | $30 copay | 40% coinsurance after deductible |
| Physical therapy visit limit | 22 visits per plan year | Combined with in-network visits |

## Limits and conditions

- Physical therapy is limited to 22 visits per plan year.
